summary: Tested Xambas recurring subscriptions module end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases green covering create (with/without start_date, invalid client/category, provider rejected), list-by-client, generate for weekly/biweekly/monthly, pause/resume/cancel state machine (409 on generate while paused, 409 on all transitions after cancel), occurrences list, plus regression on /api/matching/service-requests. Frontend: full happy path exercised through the public preview URL - registered a new client with OTP debug_code, switched to 'Servicios recurrentes' tab, created a subscription via data-testid form, verified it appeared in subscription-list, generated a visit and confirmed occurrences_count and next visit date advanced by +7 days, paused (button switched to Reanudar), resumed, opened Ver visitas (occurrence shown with scheduled date), cancelled (state -> Cancelada; actions collapsed). Regression on 'Solicitudes' tab confirmed form still renders. No console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: service.py _serialize_subscription calls count_occurrences per item on every list call (N queries). For small volumes it is fine, but for scale consider a single aggregation.

router.py has no auth dependency: any caller who knows a client_id can create/pause/cancel their subscriptions. The identity module issues session tokens but they are not enforced here. Acceptable for Fase 0 but should be revisited.

generate_occurrence advances next_run_date from the previous scheduled_date even if generation happens late; this is generally desired but if a subscription is paused for weeks the next date may still be in the past. Consider max(next+delta, today) if that is not intended.
App.jsx is 1283 lines; consider splitting RecurringPanel/NewSubscriptionForm/SubscriptionItem/OccurrencesList into their own files to stay under the 700 line guideline.
test_credentials: None pre-seeded. Tests self-register fresh clients via /api/identity/bootstrap + /otp/request (debug_code returned in dev) + /otp/verify.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed TEST_ (client + provider) and multiple subscriptions/occurrences created in Mongo. Not cleaned up (no admin delete endpoint exposed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Category id for 'Limpieza Basica' is 6a7d4c75b514b1dcdaeafdd8. Public base URL https://6a5a4228-856c-435a-9735-832a8c1fd2f3.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend does NOT hot-reload for edits under /app/apps/api (uvicorn watches /app/backend only) - if apps/api changes, ask user to sudo supervisorctl restart backend. Stripe is not configured; do not exercise payments. Recurring module uses collections 'subscriptions' and 'subscription_occurrences'.
